subject.title: feat(browser): My Browser node-anchored turn routing (stacks on #93411)

question: After PR 100619, should this PR keep any unique side-panel/node-anchored browser-copilot behavior, and if so should it be rebuilt on the canonical `driver: "extension"` implementation?
rationale: The answer determines whether this branch should be narrowed and reviewed further or replaced by a fresh side-panel-only proposal; automation cannot choose the browser UX/security direction.

options.title: Rebase and narrow
options.body: Keep only the unique side-panel/node-turn behavior, remove the parallel `extension-bridge` driver/package path, and reprove it against current main.

options.title: Close after extracting ideas
options.body: Treat PR 100619 as the canonical browser extension implementation and ask for a fresh focused PR only if maintainers still want the side-panel copilot UX.
